mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL above +20% is an always-on stay-at-home signal; it reduces trips to retail-and-recreation venues, so RETAIL_REC stays below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +20%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT reading below -70 for two consecutive weeks signals transport avoidance under tightening restrictions, which suppresses discretionary retail trips and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises above its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -70 for two consecutive weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both fall below -25 in the same week, broad avoidance of non-essential destinations is indicated, and RETAIL_REC declines further over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM < -25 and PARKS < -25 in same week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS are both below -25 in the same week, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, WORKPLACES below -50 together with RESIDENTIAL above +20 keeps workers at home and removes commuter footfall, holding RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean during a week with WORKPLACES < -50 and RESIDENTIAL > +20, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Post-holiday seasonal normalization lifts RETAIL_REC slightly over the next week from its early-January trough, independent of concurrent policy stringency.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC in the next 7 days is lower than its most recent weekly mean, the seasonal-normalization hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Pandemic fatigue after three consecutive weeks of RESIDENTIAL above +20 leads to small increases in retail and recreation trips, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean after RESIDENTIAL has been above +20 for three consecutive weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in PARKS below -25 and TRANSIT below -70 indicates reduced discretionary travel, and RETAIL_REC follows lower over the next week.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises in the next 7 days while PARKS < -25 and TRANSIT < -70, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Essential-only shopping signaled by GROCERY_PHARM below -28 keeps RETAIL_REC depressed for four weeks because non-essential retail venues remain closed under restrictions.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM is below -28, the hypothesis is rejected.
